parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the statistics of devices in the group. The default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回空间设备统计信息，默认值：false
parameters.name: include_stats

App.description_en: The name of the application used by the group

Callback.description_en: The callback URL that is used to receive device status updates in the group
Callback.description_zh: 空间内设备状态更新时的回调

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the group was created

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the group is enabled

GbId.description_en:
The GB/T 28181 ID that is associated with the group.

This parameter is returned only for groups that use the GB/T 28181 protocol for stream ingest
GbId.description_zh:
空间关联的国标ID。
仅适用于使用国标协议接入的空间

GbIp.description_en:
The IP address of the GB/T 28181 signaling server that is associated with the group.

This parameter is returned only for groups that use the GB/T 28181 protocol for stream ingest
GbIp.description_zh:
空间关联的国标信令服务器IP地址。
仅适用于使用国标协议接入的空间

GbPort.description_en:
The port of the GB/T 28181 signaling server that is associated with the group.

This parameter is returned only for groups that use the GB/T 28181 protocol for stream ingest
GbPort.description_zh:
空间关联的国标信令服务器端口。
仅适用于使用国标协议接入的空间

GbTcpPorts.description_en:
The TCP ports of the GB/T 28181 signaling server that are provided by the group.

This parameter is returned only for groups that use the GB/T 28181 protocol for stream ingest
GbTcpPorts.description_zh:
空间提供的国标信令服务器TCP端口。
仅适用于使用国标协议接入的空间

items.description_en:
The TCP ports of the GB/T 28181 signaling server that are provided by the group.

This parameter is returned only for groups that use the GB/T 28181 protocol for stream ingest
items.description_zh:
空间提供的国标信令服务器TCP端口。
仅适用于使用国标协议接入的空间

GbUdpPorts.description_en:
The UDP ports of the GB/T 28181 signaling server that are provided by the group.

This parameter is returned only for groups that use the GB/T 28181 protocol for stream ingest
GbUdpPorts.description_zh:
空间提供的国标信令服务器UDP端口。
仅适用于使用国标协议接入的空间

items.description_en:
The UDP ports of the GB/T 28181 signaling server that are provided by the group.

This parameter is returned only for groups that use the GB/T 28181 protocol for stream ingest
items.description_zh:
空间提供的国标信令服务器UDP端口。
仅适用于使用国标协议接入的空间

InProtocol.description_en:
The ingest protocol used by the group. Valid values:

gb28181

rtmp
InProtocol.description_zh:
空间使用的接入协议，取值范围：
gb28181
rtmp

LazyPull.description_en: Indicates whether on-demand stream pulling is enabled

OutProtocol.description_en:
The streaming protocol used by the group. Valid values:

flv

hls

rtmp

You can specify multiple protocols. Separate them with commas (,)
OutProtocol.description_zh:
空间使用的播放协议，取值范围：
flv
hls
rtmp
支持多个，用英文逗号（,）分隔

PlayDomain.description_en: The streaming domain used by the group

PushDomain.description_en: The ingest domain used by the group

Region.description_en: The region where the space is located, which is the service center
Region.description_zh: 空间所属区域，即服务中心

Stats.description_en: The statistics of devices in the group
Stats.description_zh: 空间内设备的统计信息

DeviceNum.description_en: The total number of devices in the group

IedNum.description_en: The number of intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) in the group

IpcNum.description_en: The number of cameras in the group

PlatformNum.description_en: The number of platforms in the group
